handbook_misprints_bounded.method: bounded by the 10 C cell of the same table
handbook_misprints_bounded.reason: Handbook prints 1265 ft, below the 1300 ft sea-level figure in the same column -- landing distance cannot fall with altitude. The other four columns rise 30-40 ft across this step, so ~1330 is intended; bounded by the 10 C cell (1365 ft) rather than computed.
